finding: The active gate is conceptually sound but its machine policy does not explicitly encode task-relative base precedence, transitive dependency closure, or semantic-strength matching for promotions.

recommended_rules.rule: N1/N2/N3 hazard categories classify structures introduced after the base declaration. A task may explicitly declare metric, embedding, stochastic, optimization, or continuum primitives in N0; the gate must then type them N0 for that task rather than blanket-forbid the vocabulary.
A definability/invariance certificate must prove the same semantic strength being promoted. Scalar or quotient invariance cannot promote an unproved relation/full object/primitive.
Every theorem-critical symbol must be covered by the declared N0 base or a typed transitive dependency DAG. Omitted/dangling dependencies yield UNRESOLVED, never NATIVE_ADMISSIBLE.

Distinguish DECLARED_N0_PRIMITIVE from N0_DEFINABLE_DERIVED. A successful promotion certificate establishes intrinsic definability/choice-independence; it does not silently rewrite the task base declaration itself.
